description: Header file defining the internal structure and methods for a media player implementation, including class SbPlayerPrivate and related functions.

classes.name: SbPlayerPrivate
classes.description: Internal class managing media player state and operations, including sample writing, seeking, and info retrieval.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new SbPlayerPrivate instance with specified codecs and callback functions.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks the media playback to a specified time.

methods.name: WriteSamples
methods.description: Template method to write media samples into the player.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream for a given media type.

methods.name: SetBounds
methods.description: Sets the display bounds for video output.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decode target for rendering.

methods.name: GetAudioConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves audio configuration at a specified index.
